title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration Networks for Software Development
authors: Yue Hu; Yuzhu Cai; Yaxin Du; Xinyu Zhu; Xiangrui Liu; Zijie Yu; Yuchen Hou; Shuo Tang; Siheng Chen
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM multi-agent systems for software development rely on human-designed, static agent workflows and topologies that cannot adapt to a specific task, and are evaluated mostly on function-level (not software-level) coding. The paper asks how a multi-agent collaboration network can self-evolve its agents and connections at test time for each task.
problem_statement.zh: 既有的 LLM 軟體開發多 agent 系統,依賴由人工設計的靜態 agent workflow 與拓撲,無法針對特定任務進行調適,且評測多集中於函式層級(而非軟體層級)的程式碼生成。本文探討多 agent 協作網路如何在測試時針對每個任務,自我演化其 agent 與連接關係。

key_innovation.en: EvoMAC treats a multi-agent collaboration (MAC) network as a differentiable-analog graph and introduces "textual backpropagation": a gradient agent converts unit-test execution feedback into per-agent textual gradients, and an updating agent applies them to add/remove agents, rewrite agent prompts, and restructure inter-agent connections, iteratively refining the whole network per task. It also proposes rSDE-Bench, a software-level (Website/Game) coding benchmark with automatically-verifiable requirements.
key_innovation.zh: EvoMAC 將多 agent 協作(MAC)網路視為一個可微分類比的圖結構,並提出「文字反向傳播」(textual backpropagation):由一個 gradient agent 將 unit-test 執行回饋轉換為各 agent 的文字梯度,再由一個 updating agent 據以新增/移除 agent、改寫 agent 的 prompt,並重構 agent 之間的連接,對整個網路逐任務地迭代精修。本文另提出 rSDE-Bench,一個具備可自動驗證需求的軟體層級(Website/Game)程式碼生成 benchmark。

baselines_compared: MetaGPT, AutoGen, MapCoder, AgentVerse, ChatDev, GPT-4o-Mini, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-1.5-Flash

key_improvements.en: On rSDE-Bench (GPT-4o-Mini backbone), EvoMAC leads every split: Website-Basic 89.38% vs 62.90% single-agent GPT-4o-Mini and 62.67% ChatDev (best baseline); Website-Advanced 65.05% vs 44.40% (single) / 43.45% (ChatDev); Game-Basic 77.54% vs 42.76% (single) / 53.63% (ChatDev, best baseline);
key_improvements.zh: 在 rSDE-Bench(GPT-4o-Mini backbone)上,EvoMAC 於每個切分皆領先:Website-Basic 89.38% 相對於單一 agent GPT-4o-Mini 的 62.90% 與 ChatDev(最佳 baseline)的 62.67%;Website-Advanced 65.05% 相對於 44.40%(單一 agent)/43.45%(ChatDev);Game-Basic 77.54% 相對於 42.76%(單一 agent)/53.63%(ChatDev,最佳 baseline);Game-Advanced 51.60% 相對於 30.10%(單一 agent)/32.26%(ChatDev)。在 HumanEval(GPT-4o-Mini backbone)上,EvoMAC 達 94.51%,相對於單一 agent GPT-4o-Mini 的 88.41% 與最佳 baseline(MapCoder / AgentVerse)的 90.85%。多 agent baseline MetaGPT 與 AgentVerse 在 Website-Advanced 上崩落至 0.00%。其自動準確率指標與人工評估的相關係數達 0.9922。

structure_space: Edge topology (spatial), Team composition (agent set), Prompts (joint)

agent_scenario.en: Single domain (software development). Three coordinated components, each itself a MAC network of LLM agents: a coding team (self-organized via a coding organizer agent) whose agents are dynamically assigned subtasks and whose team grows/shrinks per task via evolution, a testing team (self-organized via a testing organizer agent) that generates the target-proxy unit tests, and an updating team of two agents (a gradient agent producing textual gradients and an updating agent that edits the network). Tool: a code compiler / execution environment acts as the "environmental tool" producing execution logs. The number of coding agents is not fixed — it is set and revised per task by the textual-backpropagation loop.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一領域(軟體開發)。三個協調運作的組件,各自本身即為一個由 LLM agent 構成的 MAC 網路:一為 coding team(經由 coding organizer agent 自我組織),其 agent 動態分派子任務,團隊規模並隨演化逐任務地增減;二為 testing team(經由 testing organizer agent 自我組織),負責生成作為 target-proxy 的 unit test;三為由兩個 agent 組成的 updating team(一個 gradient agent 產生文字梯度,一個 updating agent 編修網路)。工具:程式碼 compiler /執行環境作為「環境工具」,產生執行 log。coding agent 的數量並非固定,而是由文字反向傳播迴圈逐任務地設定與修正。
